scenario: Configured forward zone auto-unloaded due to an RFC1918 empty-zone collision, plus an unrelated known-false-positive idns WARNING
notes: The idns WARNING here is the documented freeipa-healthcheck issue #270 false positive (ipa-ca AAAA record count) - dns_lookup independently shows all system records resolving fine, so srv-autodiscovery correctly declines to diagnose anything from that WARNING alone (falls through, no diagnosis). The real problem, the forward-zone/empty-zone collision, is only visible via the explicit bind-dyndb-ldap unload log line in journal_named, which forward-zone-conflict matches for a HIGH-confidence DIAGNOSED result.
